title: How is power supplied to a bogie-hearth furnace while its moving parts travel?
summary: Bogie travel and door lifting do not necessarily use the same power connection. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s bogie-hearth proposal dated 8 April 2022 separately describes a metal cable carrier for door heaters, moving/fixed contacts for bogie heaters and an automatic cable reel for the bogie drive. Distinguish their equipment and movement paths during installation and action checks rather than calling all three a “bogie cable”.
